title: ImageReference
description: Specifies information about the image to use. You can specify information about platform images, marketplace images, or virtual machine images.

offer.description: Specifies the offer of the platform image or marketplace image used to create the virtual machine.

version.description: Specifies the version of the platform image or marketplace image used to create the virtual machine.

exactVersion.description: Specifies in decimal numbers the version of platform image or marketplace image used to create the virtual machine.
